sentences.en: With this system a protection circuit has been built in.
sentences.zh: 在这个系统中内置了一个保护电路。

sentences.en: We are in commission concerning the protection of children's rights.
sentences.zh: 我们正在就儿童权利的保护问题进行审议。

sentences.en: The shelter offered us only insufficient protection from the storm.
sentences.zh: 这个避难所只能为我们提供不足的防风暴保护。

senses.zh: 保护, 保卫 - 贸易保护措施 - 防护物 - (向歹徒缴纳的)保护费
